metadata.name: Docker MySQL Backup
metadata.description: One-shot Bash backup script for dumping MySQL or MariaDB databases from a running Docker container to timestamped .sql or .sql.gz files with retention cleanup, latest symlink support, dry-run mode, and automation-friendly exit codes.

items.name: backup_dir
items.title: Backup Directory
items.description: Host directory where timestamped backup files are written.

items.name: mysql_database
items.title: Database Name
items.description: Database to dump, or 'all' for all databases.

items.name: mysql_password_env
items.title: Password Env Variable
items.description: Host environment variable that stores the MySQL password.

items.name: compress_backup
items.title: Compress Backup
items.description: Write gzip-compressed .sql.gz backups instead of plain .sql files.

items.name: retention_days
items.title: Retention Days
items.description: Delete matching backup files older than this many days. Use 0 to disable cleanup.

items.name: create_latest_symlink
items.title: Create Latest Symlink
items.description: Update a latest symlink next to the timestamped backup file.

items.name: dry_run
items.title: Dry Run
items.description: Print planned actions without writing backup files or deleting old backups.
